note: Models as provider:model. default: the agent's model for demos and development. bulk: the model for evaluation runs, picked by Omar on Friday (null until then; eval refuses to start without one). swap: the model_swap robustness condition, the frozen agent on a model it was not tuned on; it must differ from bulk (if bulk is anthropic:claude-haiku-5-5, use anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5).
